comparator.sourceNotes: The Amsterdam programme follows Tables 4–6 of the 2026–2027 regulations. Five taught semesters contain 41 required units totalling 150 EC, and semester five provides 30 EC of minor study. Semester six includes 5 EC of Research Skills and the 12 EC individual BSc Assignment. The University of Twente awards the degree and VU Amsterdam is the delivery partner.

audience.programmeDescription: Students design and test machines, manufacturing and energy systems, and healthcare technology. Most teaching takes place in Amsterdam, with practical work in Enschede. The University of Twente awards the degree.
audience.comparisonExplanation: The closest UCR combination combines control and signal analysis with robotics, life-cycle analysis and renewable energy technology. The Amsterdam programme also requires structural design, manufacturing, material behaviour and thermal engineering.

curriculum.routeLabel: Amsterdam curriculum, delivered by VU Amsterdam and the University of Twente
curriculum.limitation: Semester five is a 30 EC minor. The final semester includes 5 EC of Research Skills and a 12 EC individual graduation assignment.

componentNotes.me-am-202500210: Students design and build a functioning machine and receive workshop training.
componentNotes.me-am-201900019: Students analyse a home’s energy use and evaluate alternatives such as heat pumps and renewable generation.
componentNotes.me-am-202400449: Students connect product design to materials and manufacturing processes.
componentNotes.me-am-202400450: Students design and test a precision mechanism for a healthcare instrument.
componentNotes.me-am-approved-minor-free-minor: Entry requires 90 EC, including at least 52 from year one, and at most 8 EC of unfinished courses that run during the minor semester. A self-designed minor needs prior approval.
componentNotes.me-am-202100011: The project applies fluid mechanics and heat transfer through aerodynamic investigation and testing.
componentNotes.me-am-202100013: Entry requires completion of year one, at least 26 EC in semester three and 20 EC in semester four.
componentNotes.me-am-202100012: Students start the individual research assignment after their supervisor passes the proposal.
